notes: §1985:VII.1.3.5 lists the permanent-error values of a sequential file: 30 (no further information), 34 ("an attempt is made to write beyond the externally defined boundaries of a sequential file"), 35 (an OPEN INPUT, I-O or EXTEND "is attempted on a non-optional file that is not present"), 37 ("that file will not support the open mode specified in the OPEN statement"), 38 ("an OPEN statement is attempted on a file previously closed with lock") and 39 ("a conflict has been detected between the fixed file attributes and the attributes specified for that file in the program"). The runtime gives each at --std 85: SequentialConnector.OpenCore returns 35 for an absent non-optional file in the three modes; FileConnector.Open returns 37 when a present file refuses the write the mode needs (PermitsWrite, for OUTPUT, EXTEND and I-O) or the host refuses the open, and 39 when FixedAttributeConflict finds the medium contradicting the description (the framing of a RECORD IS VARYING file, or a relative/indexed store opened I-O or EXTEND); FileRegistry.CloseWithLock records the lock after a successful CLOSE WITH LOCK and SharedOpenAttempt answers 38 to every later OPEN (status 38 is the edition's own: 2023 removed it, the runtime keeps it); SequentialConnector.Write turns a host refusal into 34 when IsMediumBoundary names a full medium or a file-size limit and 30 otherwise (ForWriteFailure), and a failed read is 30 (ReadFailed). Probed at 85: OPEN INPUT, I-O and EXTEND of an absent file 35 each; OPEN OUTPUT, EXTEND and I-O of a read-only file 37 each while OPEN INPUT and READ of it are 00; OPEN OUTPUT where a directory holds the name 37; after CLOSE WITH LOCK, OPEN INPUT, OUTPUT, I-O and EXTEND 38 each; a fixed-length file opened under RECORD IS VARYING 39; an indexed file opened I-O or EXTEND as sequential 39; the USE procedure runs for each. 30 and 34 were read, not provoked (no full medium to hand). The witness closes a file WITH LOCK and shows the USE procedure run with 38 on the next OPEN.

next.reason: 30, 34 (write boundary), 35 and 37 a) are kept (§2023:9.1.13.6 GR1, GR3, GR5, GR6; restated by WRITE GR20, OPEN GR16 and GR10). Status 38 is gone: 2023 lists among removed features 'The WITH LOCK phrase of the CLOSE statement and the related File Status of 38' (§2023:E.2), and 9.1.13.6 has no 38. Status 37 adds 'insufficient authority exists to access the file' for OPEN (§2023:9.1.13.6 GR6), a new failure a 1985 OPEN can meet. Status 34 adds a READ case ('A READ statement is unsuccessfully executed because the records are variable in length' under OCCURS DEPENDING ON, §2023:9.1.13.6 GR4). 39 keeps the OPEN conflict ('a conflict has been detected between the fixed file attributes and the attributes specified for that file in the source unit', §2023:9.1.13.6 GR7) and adds DELETE FILE.
